	add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_actual key = 491 value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:tv_wonder_survey_site ?= {
				is_capital = yes
			}
		}
		remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_actual key = 491 }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_actual key = 491 value = 5 }
	}
	remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_actual key = 492 }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_actual key = 492 value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:tv_wonder_survey_site ?= {
				OR = {
					location_rank ?= location_rank:city
					location_rank ?= location_rank:megalopolis
				}
			}
		}
		remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_actual key = 492 }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_actual key = 492 value = 5 }
	}
	remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_actual key = 493 }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_actual key = 493 value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_survey_site_selected_trigger = yes }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_row_temp value = var:tv_wonder_survey_site.average_location_literacy }
		clamp_variable = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_row_temp min = 0 max = 100 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_row_temp multiply = 0.1 }
		remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_actual key = 493 }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_actual key = 493 value = var:tv_wonder_suitability_row_temp }
		remove_variable = tv_wonder_suitability_row_temp
	}
	remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_actual key = 494 }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_actual key = 494 value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_survey_site_selected_trigger = yes }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_row_temp value = var:tv_wonder_survey_site.development }
		clamp_variable = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_row_temp min = 0 max = 100 }

tv_wonder_mechanics_copy_completed_survey_from_location_effect = {
	tv_wonder_index_refresh_country_cache_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = tv_wonder_locked
			has_variable = tv_wonder_locked_mechanic_id
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_wonder_key value = var:tv_wonder_locked }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_mechanic_key value = var:tv_wonder_locked_mechanic_id }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = tv_wonder_survey_wonder_key
			has_variable = tv_wonder_survey_mechanic_key
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site
			scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site = {
				has_variable_map = tv_wonder_surveyed
				is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_surveyed target = prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_wonder_key }
			}
		}
		scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_competence
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_competence target = prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_wonder_key }
				}
				set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_location_cache_temp value = "variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_competence|prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_wonder_key)" }
				prev = { set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_scale_competence value = scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site.var:tv_wonder_survey_location_cache_temp } }
				remove_variable = tv_wonder_survey_location_cache_temp
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_logistics_competence
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_logistics_competence target = prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_wonder_key }
				}
				set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_location_cache_temp value = "variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_logistics_competence|prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_wonder_key)" }
				prev = { set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_logistics_competence value = scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site.var:tv_wonder_survey_location_cache_temp } }
				remove_variable = tv_wonder_survey_location_cache_temp
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_organization_competence
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_organization_competence target = prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_wonder_key }
				}
				set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_location_cache_temp value = "variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_organization_competence|prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_wonder_key)" }
				prev = { set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_organization_competence value = scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site.var:tv_wonder_survey_location_cache_temp } }
				remove_variable = tv_wonder_survey_location_cache_temp
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_wonder_key }
				}
				set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_location_cache_temp value = "variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_wonder_key)" }
				prev = { set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_scale_tier value = scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site.var:tv_wonder_survey_location_cache_temp } }
				remove_variable = tv_wonder_survey_location_cache_temp
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_complete value = 1 }
		remove_variable = tv_wonder_survey_active
		tv_wonder_set_io_survey_progress_effect = { value = 100 }
		tv_wonder_update_construction_tiers_from_competence_effect = yes
		tv_wonder_mechanics_calculate_suitability_actuals_effect = yes
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_row_key value = var:tv_wonder_survey_mechanic_key }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_row_key multiply = 10 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_row_key add = 1 }
		scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_suitability_actual
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_suitability_actual target = prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_row_key }
				}
				set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_location_cache_temp value = "variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_suitability_actual|prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_row_key)" }
				prev = {
					remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_actual key = var:tv_wonder_survey_row_key }
					add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_actual key = var:tv_wonder_survey_row_key value = scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site.var:tv_wonder_survey_location_cache_temp }
				}
				remove_variable = tv_wonder_survey_location_cache_temp
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_row_key value = var:tv_wonder_survey_mechanic_key }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_row_key multiply = 10 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_row_key add = 2 }
		scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_suitability_actual
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_suitability_actual target = prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_row_key }
				}
				set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_location_cache_temp value = "variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_suitability_actual|prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_row_key)" }
				prev = {
					remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_actual key = var:tv_wonder_survey_row_key }
					add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_actual key = var:tv_wonder_survey_row_key value = scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site.var:tv_wonder_survey_location_cache_temp }
				}
				remove_variable = tv_wonder_survey_location_cache_temp
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_row_key value = var:tv_wonder_survey_mechanic_key }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_row_key multiply = 10 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_row_key add = 3 }
		scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_suitability_actual
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_suitability_actual target = prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_row_key }
				}
				set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_location_cache_temp value = "variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_suitability_actual|prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_row_key)" }
				prev = {
					remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_actual key = var:tv_wonder_survey_row_key }
					add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_actual key = var:tv_wonder_survey_row_key value = scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site.var:tv_wonder_survey_location_cache_temp }
				}
				remove_variable = tv_wonder_survey_location_cache_temp
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_row_key value = var:tv_wonder_survey_mechanic_key }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_row_key multiply = 10 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_row_key add = 4 }
		scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_suitability_actual
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_suitability_actual target = prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_row_key }
				}
				set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_location_cache_temp value = "variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_suitability_actual|prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_row_key)" }
				prev = {
					remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_actual key = var:tv_wonder_survey_row_key }
					add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_actual key = var:tv_wonder_survey_row_key value = scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site.var:tv_wonder_survey_location_cache_temp }
				}
				remove_variable = tv_wonder_survey_location_cache_temp
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_row_key value = var:tv_wonder_survey_mechanic_key }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_row_key multiply = 10 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_row_key add = 5 }
		scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_suitability_actual
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_suitability_actual target = prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_row_key }
				}
				set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_location_cache_temp value = "variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_suitability_actual|prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_row_key)" }
				prev = {
					remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_actual key = var:tv_wonder_survey_row_key }
					add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_actual key = var:tv_wonder_survey_row_key value = scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site.var:tv_wonder_survey_location_cache_temp }
				}
				remove_variable = tv_wonder_survey_location_cache_temp
			}
		}
		tv_wonder_mechanics_refresh_current_suitability_display_cache_effect = yes
	}
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_survey_row_key
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_survey_mechanic_key
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_survey_wonder_key
}

tv_wonder_mechanics_clear_completed_survey_from_location_effect = {
	tv_wonder_index_refresh_country_cache_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site
			has_variable = tv_wonder_locked
			has_variable = tv_wonder_locked_mechanic_id
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_wonder_key value = var:tv_wonder_locked }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_mechanic_key value = var:tv_wonder_locked_mechanic_id }
		scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site = {
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_surveyed key = prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_wonder_key }
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_competence key = prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_wonder_key }
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_logistics_competence key = prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_wonder_key }
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_organization_competence key = prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_wonder_key }
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier key = prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_wonder_key }
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_row_key value = var:tv_wonder_survey_mechanic_key }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_row_key multiply = 10 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_row_key add = 1 }
		scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site = {
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_suitability_actual key = prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_row_key }
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_row_key value = var:tv_wonder_survey_mechanic_key }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_row_key multiply = 10 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_row_key add = 2 }
		scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site = {
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_suitability_actual key = prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_row_key }
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_row_key value = var:tv_wonder_survey_mechanic_key }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_row_key multiply = 10 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_row_key add = 3 }
		scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site = {
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_suitability_actual key = prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_row_key }
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_row_key value = var:tv_wonder_survey_mechanic_key }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_row_key multiply = 10 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_row_key add = 4 }
		scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site = {
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_suitability_actual key = prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_row_key }
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_row_key value = var:tv_wonder_survey_mechanic_key }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_row_key multiply = 10 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_row_key add = 5 }
		scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site = {

		remove_variable = tv_wonder_survey_wonder_key
	}

tv_wonder_mechanics_store_survey_on_location_effect = {
	tv_wonder_index_refresh_country_cache_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			tv_wonder_survey_site_selected_trigger = yes
			has_variable = tv_wonder_locked
			has_variable = tv_wonder_locked_mechanic_id
		}
		tv_wonder_mechanics_calculate_suitability_actuals_effect = yes
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_wonder_key value = var:tv_wonder_locked }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_mechanic_key value = var:tv_wonder_locked_mechanic_id }
		var:tv_wonder_survey_site ?= {
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_surveyed key = prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_wonder_key }
			add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_surveyed key = prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_wonder_key value = 1 }
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_competence key = prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_wonder_key }
			add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_competence key = prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_wonder_key value = prev.var:tv_wonder_scale_competence }
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_logistics_competence key = prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_wonder_key }
			add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_logistics_competence key = prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_wonder_key value = prev.var:tv_wonder_logistics_competence }
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_organization_competence key = prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_wonder_key }
			add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_organization_competence key = prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_wonder_key value = prev.var:tv_wonder_organization_competence }
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier key = prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_wonder_key }
			add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier key = prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_wonder_key value = prev.var:tv_wonder_scale_tier }
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_row_key value = var:tv_wonder_survey_mechanic_key }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_row_key multiply = 10 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_row_key add = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable_map = tv_wonder_suitability_actual
				is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_actual target = var:tv_wonder_survey_row_key }
			}
			set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_location_cache_temp value = "variable_map(tv_wonder_suitability_actual|var:tv_wonder_survey_row_key)" }
			var:tv_wonder_survey_site ?= {
				remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_suitability_actual key = prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_row_key }
				add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_suitability_actual key = prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_row_key value = prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_location_cache_temp }
			}
			remove_variable = tv_wonder_survey_location_cache_temp
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_row_key value = var:tv_wonder_survey_mechanic_key }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_row_key multiply = 10 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_row_key add = 2 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable_map = tv_wonder_suitability_actual
				is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_actual target = var:tv_wonder_survey_row_key }
			}
			set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_location_cache_temp value = "variable_map(tv_wonder_suitability_actual|var:tv_wonder_survey_row_key)" }
			var:tv_wonder_survey_site ?= {
				remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_suitability_actual key = prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_row_key }
				add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_suitability_actual key = prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_row_key value = prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_location_cache_temp }
			}
			remove_variable = tv_wonder_survey_location_cache_temp
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_row_key value = var:tv_wonder_survey_mechanic_key }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_row_key multiply = 10 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_row_key add = 3 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable_map = tv_wonder_suitability_actual
				is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_actual target = var:tv_wonder_survey_row_key }
			}
			set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_location_cache_temp value = "variable_map(tv_wonder_suitability_actual|var:tv_wonder_survey_row_key)" }
			var:tv_wonder_survey_site ?= {
				remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_suitability_actual key = prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_row_key }
				add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_suitability_actual key = prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_row_key value = prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_location_cache_temp }
			}
			remove_variable = tv_wonder_survey_location_cache_temp
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_row_key value = var:tv_wonder_survey_mechanic_key }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_row_key multiply = 10 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_row_key add = 4 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable_map = tv_wonder_suitability_actual
				is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_actual target = var:tv_wonder_survey_row_key }
			}
			set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_location_cache_temp value = "variable_map(tv_wonder_suitability_actual|var:tv_wonder_survey_row_key)" }
			var:tv_wonder_survey_site ?= {
				remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_suitability_actual key = prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_row_key }
				add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_suitability_actual key = prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_row_key value = prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_location_cache_temp }
			}
			remove_variable = tv_wonder_survey_location_cache_temp
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_row_key value = var:tv_wonder_survey_mechanic_key }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_row_key multiply = 10 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_row_key add = 5 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable_map = tv_wonder_suitability_actual
				is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_actual target = var:tv_wonder_survey_row_key }
			}
			set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_location_cache_temp value = "variable_map(tv_wonder_suitability_actual|var:tv_wonder_survey_row_key)" }
			var:tv_wonder_survey_site ?= {
				remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_suitability_actual key = prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_row_key }
				add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_suitability_actual key = prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_row_key value = prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_location_cache_temp }
			}

		remove_variable = tv_wonder_survey_mechanic_key
		remove_variable = tv_wonder_survey_wonder_key
	}

tv_wonder_mechanics_apply_survey_site_preference_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 1
			tv_wonder_survey_site_selected_trigger = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_wonder_survey_site ?= { topography = mountains } }
		tv_wonder_change_all_survey_competence_target_effect = { value = 15 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:tv_wonder_survey_site ?= { topography = plateau } }
		tv_wonder_change_all_survey_competence_target_effect = { value = 7.5 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:tv_wonder_survey_site ?= { topography = hills } }
		tv_wonder_change_all_survey_competence_target_effect = { value = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_wonder_survey_site ?= { vegetation = forest } }
		tv_wonder_change_all_survey_competence_target_effect = { value = 10 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:tv_wonder_survey_site ?= { vegetation = woods } }
		tv_wonder_change_all_survey_competence_target_effect = { value = 5 }
		}
		tv_wonder_calculate_sacred_mountain_suitability_actuals_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 2
			tv_wonder_survey_site_selected_trigger = yes
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_site_preference_bonus value = var:tv_wonder_survey_site.development }
		clamp_variable = { name = tv_wonder_site_preference_bonus min = 0 max = 100 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_site_preference_bonus multiply = 0.2 }
		tv_wonder_change_all_survey_competence_target_effect = { value = var:tv_wonder_site_preference_bonus }
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_wonder_survey_site ?= { location_rank ?= location_rank:megalopolis } }
		tv_wonder_change_all_survey_competence_target_effect = { value = 5 }
		}
		remove_variable = tv_wonder_site_preference_bonus
		tv_wonder_calculate_triumphal_axis_suitability_actuals_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 3
			tv_wonder_survey_site_selected_trigger = yes
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_site_preference_bonus value = var:tv_wonder_survey_site.modifier:harbor_suitability }
		clamp_variable = { name = tv_wonder_site_preference_bonus min = 0 max = 1 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_site_preference_bonus multiply = 25 }
		tv_wonder_change_all_survey_competence_target_effect = { value = var:tv_wonder_site_preference_bonus }
		remove_variable = tv_wonder_site_preference_bonus
		tv_wonder_calculate_great_port_suitability_actuals_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 4
			tv_wonder_survey_site_selected_trigger = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_wonder_survey_site ?= { topography = hills } }
		tv_wonder_change_all_survey_competence_target_effect = { value = 15 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_wonder_survey_site ?= { any_neighbor_location = { tv_wonder_location_is_city_trigger = yes } } }
		tv_wonder_change_all_survey_competence_target_effect = { value = 10 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:tv_wonder_survey_site ?= { any_neighbor_location = { tv_wonder_location_is_town_trigger = yes } } }
		tv_wonder_change_all_survey_competence_target_effect = { value = 5 }
		}
		tv_wonder_calculate_giant_necropolis_suitability_actuals_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 5
			tv_wonder_survey_site_selected_trigger = yes
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_site_preference_bonus value = var:tv_wonder_survey_site.modifier:harbor_suitability }
		clamp_variable = { name = tv_wonder_site_preference_bonus min = 0 max = 1 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_site_preference_bonus multiply = 25 }
		tv_wonder_change_all_survey_competence_target_effect = { value = var:tv_wonder_site_preference_bonus }
		remove_variable = tv_wonder_site_preference_bonus
		tv_wonder_calculate_great_lighthouse_suitability_actuals_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 6
			tv_wonder_survey_site_selected_trigger = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_wonder_survey_site ?= { location_rank ?= location_rank:city } }
			tv_wonder_change_all_survey_competence_target_effect = { value = 5 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_wonder_survey_site ?= { location_rank ?= location_rank:megalopolis } }
			tv_wonder_change_all_survey_competence_target_effect = { value = 10 }
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_site_preference_bonus value = var:tv_wonder_survey_site.total_building_levels }
		clamp_variable = { name = tv_wonder_site_preference_bonus min = 0 max = 100 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_site_preference_bonus multiply = 0.05 }
		tv_wonder_change_all_survey_competence_target_effect = { value = var:tv_wonder_site_preference_bonus }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_site_preference_bonus value = var:tv_wonder_survey_site.development }
		clamp_variable = { name = tv_wonder_site_preference_bonus min = 0 max = 100 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_site_preference_bonus multiply = 0.1 }
		tv_wonder_change_all_survey_competence_target_effect = { value = var:tv_wonder_site_preference_bonus }
		remove_variable = tv_wonder_site_preference_bonus
		tv_wonder_calculate_hydraulic_workshop_suitability_actuals_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 7
			tv_wonder_survey_site_selected_trigger = yes
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_site_preference_bonus value = var:tv_wonder_survey_site.development }
		clamp_variable = { name = tv_wonder_site_preference_bonus min = 0 max = 100 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_site_preference_bonus multiply = 0.2 }
		tv_wonder_change_all_survey_competence_target_effect = { value = var:tv_wonder_site_preference_bonus }
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_wonder_survey_site ?= { location_rank ?= location_rank:rural_settlement } }
		tv_wonder_change_all_survey_competence_target_effect = { value = 5 }
		}
		remove_variable = tv_wonder_site_preference_bonus
		tv_wonder_calculate_mining_city_suitability_actuals_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 8
			tv_wonder_survey_site_selected_trigger = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_wonder_survey_site ?= { topography = mountains } }
		tv_wonder_change_all_survey_competence_target_effect = { value = 15 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:tv_wonder_survey_site ?= { topography = plateau } }
		tv_wonder_change_all_survey_competence_target_effect = { value = 7.5 }
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_site_preference_bonus value = var:tv_wonder_survey_site.average_location_literacy }

		tv_wonder_change_logistics_competence_target_effect = { value = 20 }
		tv_wonder_change_organization_competence_target_effect = { value = 20 }
		tv_wonder_calculate_unique_sankore_university_suitability_actuals_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 222
			tv_wonder_survey_site_selected_trigger = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_wonder_survey_site ?= { has_building = building_type:monastery } }
		tv_wonder_change_all_survey_competence_target_effect = { value = 5 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_wonder_survey_site ?= { has_building = building_type:cathedral } }
		tv_wonder_change_all_survey_competence_target_effect = { value = 5 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_wonder_survey_site ?= { dominant_religion = owner.religion } }
		tv_wonder_change_all_survey_competence_target_effect = { value = 15 }
		}
		tv_wonder_change_scale_competence_target_effect = { value = 100 }
		tv_wonder_change_logistics_competence_target_effect = { value = 20 }
		tv_wonder_change_organization_competence_target_effect = { value = 20 }
		tv_wonder_calculate_unique_great_mosque_of_djenne_suitability_actuals_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 223
			tv_wonder_survey_site_selected_trigger = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_wonder_survey_site ?= { topography = mountains } }
		tv_wonder_change_all_survey_competence_target_effect = { value = 15 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:tv_wonder_survey_site ?= { topography = plateau } }
		tv_wonder_change_all_survey_competence_target_effect = { value = 7.5 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_wonder_survey_site ?= { modifier:fort_level > 0 } }
		tv_wonder_change_all_survey_competence_target_effect = { value = 5 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_wonder_survey_site ?= { OR = { location_rank ?= location_rank:city location_rank ?= location_rank:megalopolis } } }
		tv_wonder_change_all_survey_competence_target_effect = { value = 5 }
		}
		tv_wonder_change_scale_competence_target_effect = { value = 100 }
		tv_wonder_change_logistics_competence_target_effect = { value = 20 }
		tv_wonder_change_organization_competence_target_effect = { value = 20 }
		tv_wonder_calculate_unique_walls_of_benin_suitability_actuals_effect = yes
	}
}

tv_wonder_mechanics_start_survey_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:target
		}
		tv_wonder_clear_current_survey_effect = yes
		tv_wonder_mechanics_clear_suitability_actuals_effect = yes
		scope:target = { save_scope_as = tv_wonder_selected_survey_site }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_site value = scope:target }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_stage value = 2 }
		if = {
			limit = { tv_wonder_selected_survey_already_cached_trigger = yes }
			tv_wonder_copy_completed_survey_from_location_effect = yes
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_active value = 1 }
			tv_wonder_prepare_survey_competence_targets_effect = yes
			tv_wonder_set_io_survey_progress_effect = { value = 0 }
		}
	}
}

tv_wonder_mechanics_complete_survey_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_survey_active_trigger = yes }
		clamp_variable = { name = tv_wonder_scale_competence min = 0 max = 100 }
		clamp_variable = { name = tv_wonder_logistics_competence min = 0 max = 100 }
		clamp_variable = { name = tv_wonder_organization_competence min = 0 max = 100 }
		tv_wonder_update_construction_tiers_from_competence_effect = yes
		tv_wonder_store_survey_on_location_effect = yes
		tv_wonder_mechanics_reveal_suitability_knowledge_effect = yes
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_complete value = 1 }
		remove_variable = tv_wonder_survey_active
		remove_variable = tv_wonder_survey_speed
		remove_variable = tv_wonder_scale_competence_target
		remove_variable = tv_wonder_logistics_competence_target
		remove_variable = tv_wonder_organization_competence_target
		remove_variable = tv_wonder_scale_competence_monthly_gain
		remove_variable = tv_wonder_logistics_competence_monthly_gain
		remove_variable = tv_wonder_organization_competence_monthly_gain
		tv_wonder_set_io_survey_progress_effect = { value = 100 }
		if = {
			limit = { tv_wonder_survey_site_selected_trigger = yes }
			var:tv_wonder_survey_site ?= { save_scope_as = tv_wonder_event_location }
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_competence_average value = var:tv_wonder_scale_competence }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_competence_average add = var:tv_wonder_logistics_competence }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_competence_average add = var:tv_wonder_organization_competence }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_competence_average divide = 3 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.300 days = 1 }
	}
}

tv_wonder_mechanics_reveal_suitability_knowledge_effect = {
	tv_wonder_index_refresh_country_cache_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = tv_wonder_locked_mechanic_id
			has_global_variable_map = tv_wonder_mechanic_id_to_suitability_row_count
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_mechanic_key value = var:tv_wonder_locked_mechanic_id }
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_mechanic_id_to_suitability_row_count target = local_var:tv_wonder_suitability_mechanic_key }
			}
			set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_row_count value = "global_variable_map(tv_wonder_mechanic_id_to_suitability_row_count|local_var:tv_wonder_suitability_mechanic_key)" }
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_suitability_revealed }
						AND = {
							has_variable_map = tv_wonder_suitability_revealed
							NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_revealed target = local_var:tv_wonder_suitability_mechanic_key } }
						}
					}
				}
				remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_revealed key = local_var:tv_wonder_suitability_mechanic_key }
				add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_revealed key = local_var:tv_wonder_suitability_mechanic_key value = 0 }
			}
			set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_reveal_value value = "variable_map(tv_wonder_suitability_revealed|local_var:tv_wonder_suitability_mechanic_key)" }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:tv_wonder_suitability_reveal_value < local_var:tv_wonder_suitability_row_count }
				change_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_reveal_value add = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:tv_wonder_suitability_reveal_value > local_var:tv_wonder_suitability_row_count }
				set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_reveal_value value = local_var:tv_wonder_suitability_row_count }
			}
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_revealed key = local_var:tv_wonder_suitability_mechanic_key }
			add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_revealed key = local_var:tv_wonder_suitability_mechanic_key value = local_var:tv_wonder_suitability_reveal_value }
			tv_wonder_mechanics_refresh_current_suitability_display_cache_effect = yes
			remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_suitability_reveal_value
			remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_suitability_row_count
		}
		remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_suitability_mechanic_key
	}
}
